verdict.rationale: Temporal's evidence shows workflows can be started and signaled programmatically from app code through the Temporal Client (Start, Signal) and message handlers that act like endpoints, and a workflow can invoke many Activities. However, nothing shows declarative event, webhook or queue triggers, or one event fanning out to multiple subscribed functions. Wiring events to workflows appears to require your own client code. Missing for 10: declarative event/webhook/queue trigger bindings, built-in event fan-out to multiple functions, independent corroboration of event-driven triggering.
